text: Entry 1503 changes the selected-count Fluent message to one/other branches and updates its caller. Both English branches currently say selected, but other locales can require different forms. Proposed rule for this count label: pass the actual count as a numeric Fluent argument and document its meaning; do not remove the plural structure merely because the English rendering is identical. Static source and test-code inspection only. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime or live accessibility result is claimed.
title: Keep a plural branch even when English selected-count text is identical
